name: PWN-Boost: progressive winsorization
tagline: AdaBoost on classification; for regression, Newton step on residuals that are percentile-clipped at a round-dependent threshold scaled with sqrt(n), plus optional non-compounding residual-focus reweighting.

key_hyperparams.name: clip_growth
key_hyperparams.role: growth factor on clip pct over rounds

init_recovers: xgboost_style baseline at base_clip_pct = 0 and use_focus = false
diff_from_baseline: Strict superset of the xgboost_style baseline for regression: adds round-progressive percentile-clipping of residuals plus a sample-size-scaled Newton lambda and an optional non-compounding focus reweighting; classification reduces to AdaBoost.

name: ASBHW: Newton step + hybrid reweighting
tagline: XGBoost-style Newton learner weight, but combined with AdaBoost.R2 reweighting for regression and a temperature-decayed margin/grad confidence reweighting for classification.

key_hyperparams.name: temperature_base
key_hyperparams.role: starting temp for confidence-weighted classification update

init_recovers: xgboost_style baseline at temperature reweighting disabled; AdaBoost.R2 baseline at lambda → ∞
diff_from_baseline: Combines the xgboost_style Newton step with the adaboost reweighting families: regression uses AdaBoost.R2 reweighting on top of the Newton alpha; classification uses a margin/gradient confidence-weighted exponential update (decayed temperature) instead of plain AdaBoost.

name: Bayesian-bootstrap Newton boosting
tagline: Replace sample weights with exponential bootstrap noise multiplied by the Hessian; Newton step on (g/h+lambda); classification clamps targets in [-20, 20] and regression scales alpha 2.5x for n>5000.
diff_from_baseline: Goes beyond the xgboost_style baseline by replacing uniform sample weights with Hessian-times-Bayesian-bootstrap weights, clamping targets, and amplifying the Newton step on large regression problems.

name: Bandpass boosting (margin + trust-region)
tagline: AdaBoost classification with margin-bandpass reweighting; small-data regression uses trust-region pseudo-Huber residuals plus a focus-vs-uniform interpolation; large-data regression falls back to plain Newton.

key_hyperparams.name: bandpass_strength
key_hyperparams.role: weight bonus on low-margin classification samples

key_hyperparams.name: focus_curve
key_hyperparams.role: interpolation between uniform and informative weights

init_recovers: AdaBoost classification at bandpass=1; xgboost_style regression at large-data branch
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid of AdaBoost (with extra margin-bandpass reweighting), and an xgboost-style Newton step over robust pseudo-Huber residuals with informative-difficulty reweighting; falls back to standard Newton boosting for n>5000.

name: AdaBoost-margin clf + Newton-step regression
tagline: Classification: AdaBoost alpha then exp(-tanh-margin) reweighting with linearly increasing temperature. Regression: Newton step alpha = <r,h>/(|h|^2 + 1), no reweighting.

key_hyperparams.name: temp_curve
key_hyperparams.role: linearly increasing temperature for margin reweighting

init_recovers: AdaBoost at temp=0; gradient_boosting baseline for regression
diff_from_baseline: Combines AdaBoost's exponential update with a tanh-margin reweighting whose temperature grows with the round; regression uses the xgboost_style Newton learner-weight formula with lambda=1 and uniform sample weights.
